note: Derived from the XLeRobot model (owner: source of truth), not measured on the robot. Base spacing from the model Base origins; base height above the carton support and setback kept from the simulation. Policy cameras: front (head OAK), left_wrist, right_wrist. The overhead camera does not exist on the robot and is not a policy input.

station.sources: xlerobot.xml: Base/Base_2 at y=-/+0.11; height/setback: simulation

front.sources: xlerobot.xml: head_camera_link at head_tilt_joint 58 deg, head_pan_joint 0.0 deg; OAK-D Lite colour VFOV 54.0 deg (4:3 spec)

left_wrist.sources: xlerobot.xml: Left_Arm_Camera lens via ICP of Fixed_Jaw onto SO101 gripper_link (1.7 mm RMS); vertical FOV 90.0 deg assumed

right_wrist.sources: xlerobot.xml: Right_Arm_Camera lens via ICP of Fixed_Jaw onto SO101 gripper_link (1.7 mm RMS); vertical FOV 90.0 deg assumed
